hypotheses.claim: A first-class provenance-bound PerceptualEmbeddingHandle between libmtmd vision encoding, MVC readout and delayed semantic decode can make QNDRF's one-encode/zero-or-one-decode law executable without a second heavy visual encoder.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: Current llama-server obtains mtmd output embeddings separately but consumes them inside slot/request processing; Qwen3.5 multi-turn image reprocessing has also been reported. QNDRF therefore needs an explicit measured lifetime/reuse contract rather than assuming server cache semantics.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Copying/retaining visual embeddings plus compatibility bookkeeping costs enough RAM/bandwidth/latency that direct Qwen decode or a tiny dedicated embedding encoder is Pareto-superior; target runtime may also already eliminate re-encoding in the relevant workload.
hypotheses.falsifier: On matched recurring-GUI episodes, a PEH path fails to reduce actual vision-encode count or end-to-end sensor-to-correct-decision cost without accuracy/open-set/recovery regression versus FULL_QWEN and dedicated-encoder baselines.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Instrument target libmtmd path: count mtmd_batch_encode, bytes copied/retained, delayed decode reuse, p50/p95/p99, RAM/VRAM and semantic equivalence across repeated observations.

hypotheses.claim: Raw final Qwen3.5 vision outputs should remain the diagnostic Q0 baseline, while a tiny calibrated learned projection/readout Q1 is the stronger operational candidate for user-specific familiarity/open-set routing.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: Strong multimodal embedding systems derived from VLMs use explicit contrastive/distillation objectives; this is counterevidence against assuming raw generative-VLM geometry is already calibrated for identity/open-set distance.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: For Frank's narrow recurring GUI/entity states, deterministic pooling plus raw prototype distances are already sufficient and avoid learned-head drift/data requirements.
hypotheses.falsifier: Q0 matches or beats Q1 on held-out exact/state-variant/near-neighbor unknown fixtures under equal calibration error, false-familiar tolerance and total cost.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Frozen Qwen features; compare Q0 pooled prototypes vs Q1 tiny projection on the same independent episodes with AUROC/AUPR, ECE, FPR@known-recall and resource shadows.

hypotheses.claim: Multimodal runtime parameters such as batch/ubatch, mmproj offload, backend, flash-attention and parallel/KV mode must be treated as semantic-correctness benchmark metadata, not performance metadata only.
hypotheses.why_it_matters: Current llama.cpp issue evidence shows multimodal correctness/reprocessing/resource behavior can vary with runtime configuration on Qwen3.5-family workloads.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Observed failures are isolated to other model sizes/hardware/backends and do not transfer to the exact 4B target lane.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact target 4B differential matrix shows invariant visual outputs/task correctness across supported runtime configurations within declared numerical tolerance.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Small frozen image/UI corpus across a bounded target-VPS runtime configuration matrix before collecting MVC training/prototype data.
